messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server installation as non-root user
parts:
Shiny Server was primarily designed to let many users deploy Shiny apps on a server, with each app executing with its author's permissions (what the config docs now call "autouser" mode). In order to launch processes as another user, the server process needs to be root.

With the other models of deployment, there isn't a technical reason why the server would need to run as root (unless you wanted to use ports below 1024) as long as the active user is the same as the user that is specified in the config file. But we haven't modified the code that would need to check for this condition and launch the process differently.
